text_block_list.text:
Zenno Rob Roy got injured during training,
so I brought her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"...It was all because I let my guard down...
I'm so sorry for causing trouble..."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Um... Trainer-san. If possible,
I'd like to get back to training...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
The pain is gone now...!
They treated it for me...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"...Um... I just feel like if I rest now,
the path to becoming a hero will slip further away..."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
choice_data_list: Let's make sure you get proper rest for now.
Can you promise me you won't do anything reckless?
Can you promise me you won't do anything reckless?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
choice_data_list: Let's make sure you get proper rest for now.
Can you promise me you won't do anything reckless?
Can you promise me you won't do anything reckless?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Yes...
...I'm sorry for being so selfish.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...Still, I get anxious if I'm not doing something...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Um... would it be alright if I
distracted myself with some reading...?

Zenno Rob Roy quietly read her book
and got a good, proper rest.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Yes, a promise... No, I swear an oath...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"I definitely won't overdo it.
Well then, I'm heading back to training...!"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"...When I move it, it hurts...
No way..."
I suspended training and had Zenno Rob Roy rest as she complained of pain...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah... It seems to be fine.
There is no pain."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"...Alright, I need to make up for
falling behind on today's quota...!"

Zenno Rob Roy got through her training
without overexerting herself!
